description.zh: 川越因保留了大量江户时代藏造（蔵造り）建筑而被称为「小江户」，是距东京最近的历史街区。蔵造り老街一字排开的黑色漆灰泥防火商铺、时の鐘（古老的钟楼报时塔）和菓子横丁（糖果小巷），令访客仿佛穿越回200年前的城下町。
description.en: Kawagoe is dubbed 'Little Edo' for its well-preserved rows of kurazukuri (storehouse-style) buildings from the Edo period — the closest historic townscape to Tokyo. Black-plastered fireproof merchant houses, the landmark Toki no Kane bell tower and Kashiya Yokocho 'Candy Lane' combine to evoke a castle town of 200 years ago.

zh: 蔵造りの町并み：约1公里保存完好的江户建筑街道，含30余栋国家重要文化财
时の鐘：江户时代第三代藩主建造的时钟楼，至今每日报时四次
菓子屋横丁：售卖传统菓子（甘薯糖、糖果等）的古朴小巷，约20家甜品老铺
en: Kurazukuri townscape: ~1 km of preserved Edo-era streetscape with 30+ nationally designated Important Cultural Properties
Toki no Kane: the time bell tower built by the third domain lord in the Edo period; still chimes four times daily
Kashiya Yokocho: a charming alley of ~20 traditional sweet shops selling satsumaimo candy and old-fashioned confections

admission.zh: 街区免费；川越城本丸御殿100日元
admission.en: Streets free; Kawagoe Castle Hon-maru Palace ¥100

tips.zh: 从东京池袋乘东武东上线特急约30分钟至川越站，或从新宿乘JR川越线约50分钟。10月举行的川越祭（山车巡行）是国家指定重要无形民俗文化财。
tips.en: From Ikebukuro, take the Tobu-Tojo Line Limited Express ~30 minutes to Kawagoe. The Kawagoe Festival in October — with dashi float processions — is a nationally designated Intangible Folk Cultural Property.

description.zh: 三峯神社位于秩父山地深处，海拔约1,100米，是日本最具神秘气场的神社之一，以守护与赐予气力的「お犬さま」（神狼）信仰著称。神社周边原始森林遮天蔽日，尤以晨雾弥漫时云海翻腾宛若仙境，被誉为「关东最灵验的能量景点」。
description.en: Mitsumine Shrine sits deep in the Chichibu mountains at ~1,100 m elevation, one of Japan's most spiritually charged sanctuaries. It is renowned for its ookami-sama (divine wolf) guardians, believed to grant protection and vital energy. Ancient forest and morning sea-of-clouds make this a celebrated 'power spot' in the Kanto region.

zh: 随身守（お犬さま）：以铁铸狼形御守著称，每月1日有限量白色木制气力守护御守
随身门（随身門）：以雕刻精美的涂金狛犬（神狼）守护的神社大门
清龙权现滝：距神社徒步约30分钟的山中瀑布，适合进阶徒步者
en: Wolf guardian amulets: the iron wolf okken are the shrine's signature; limited white 'power' amulets released on the 1st of each month
Zuishinmon Gate: entrance gate flanked by elaborately carved, gold-leafed wolf komainu
Seiryu-gongen waterfall: a ~30-minute hike from the shrine for more adventurous visitors

admission.en: Free to worship; amulets sold separately

duration.en: Half to full day including travel

tips.zh: 从西武秩父站乘巴士约75分钟至三峯神社。每月1日限定的白色气力守护御守极受欢迎，可能需要当日清晨排队。冬季积雪路滑，需事先确认道路状况。
tips.en: Take a bus ~75 minutes from Seibu-Chichibu Station. The limited white power amulets on the 1st of each month may require early-morning queuing. Roads can be icy in winter — check conditions in advance.
